metadata.title: Bihar Mahaparv Chhath Puja छठ पूजा Series starting on 9th December 2023 #chhathpuja #bihar #shorts
metadata.description: Celebrating Maha Chhat Parv in Bihar was an incredible experience. Stay tuned as we launch our series this Saturday about this mega celebration. Don't miss out on the chance to explore the colors, flavours and traditions that make Maha Chhat Parv an unforgettable experience.
